name: Gen 2 - R2-D2 blue / Naboo, 72 segments (layout unverified)
verification_note: Segments 1-36 are confirmed identical to Gen 1: their label pads sit at x = 14, 42, 70, 98, 126, 154, 182, 210, 238 mm and y = 15.125, 45.375, 75.625, 105.875 mm on both drawings. Twelve of the edge segments are NOT confirmed - on Coordinates(blue).pdf the label pads of 39, 40, 49, 51, 52, 54, 55, 57, 58, 60, 69 and 70 sit at different positions from the green plate (39 and 69 at y=45.375 rather than 51.425; 40 and 70 at y=75.625 rather than 69.575; 49 and 54 at x=58.8 and 55 and 60 at x=193.2, neither of which is a Gen-1 label column; 51, 52, 57 and 58 at x=98 and x=154, which are wide-strip columns). A label pad marks where a number is printed, not where a segment ends, so those positions do not determine the boundaries. Until somebody reads the boundaries off the copper layer or the KiCad board file, this file carries the Gen-1 tiling, which is right for the other 60 segments and may be wrong for those 12. Correct the rectangles below and set verified to true.
notes: Pad grid, plate size and segment count are certain from Coordinates(blue).pdf: 45 x 20 pads of 5.6 x 6.05 mm = 900 pads over 252.0 x 121.0 mm, 72 segments, temperature sensors at x = 0, 84, 168, 252 mm. The Naboo calibration campaign confirms 72 segment channels and 4 sensors.
